## What's new in 1.3.0

**Website pages** (new output)
- A whole page for the brand's WordPress site, laid out from the approved words: `run.sh web`. A hero, sections that each open with a heading, media rows, feature cards, a card stack, a band, the closing card and an FAQ.
- Each build gives the page's block markup to paste into a new draft's Code editor, a page file (template and page settings, search title, description, keyphrase, image slots) and the piece's photos ready to upload.
- The build places the spacing, the end of the page and the sides by itself: headings and media rows alternate down the page, so moving sections in design mode keeps the zigzag.
- A brand with its own site components gets those (Case Amplify: its Kadence patterns, motion and CTA card, so pasted pages stay editable like the rest of the site); any other brand gets plain WordPress blocks.
- Every build is checked with WordPress's own block parser, and the build checks the page rules: one closing card, a heading for every group, one accent word per heading, the site's motion and icons, alt text.
- `run.sh web compare` lists every block that changed between two saved pages, so edits made in WordPress carry into the next build.
